SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 r0.2 — TARGETED STAGE B
FORMAL-CLOSURE AND CROSS-PACKAGE-BOUNDARY DIRECTIVE

The SCI-FLT-FIXED r0.1 architecture is approved as the basis for the next
targeted revision.

Preserve:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED as the package name;
- SCI-FLT-INF as a non-authored recovery/holding tranche only;
- strict linearity with no additive term;
- y = J_full L_Theta m as the organizing applied relation;
- fixed convolution as the first concrete family;
- fixed low-pass convolution only as a qualified fixed-convolution subtype;
- full-footprint-only as the sole v0.1 edge method;
- no extension, wrapping, truncation, support renormalization, replacement,
  reprojection, resampling, deconvolution, or data-derived selection;
- exact MAP-observation, MAP-coadd, and JINC-observation parent roles;
- no assumed filter/coadd commutation;
- transformed parent-unit amplitude rather than fitted/template amplitude;
- no automatic filtered-beam or calibration claim;
- exact response and covariance composition when compatible parent objects
  exist;
- honest unavailable companion states;
- fixed-state NOI parity;
- disabled, identity, zero, unavailable, failed, and realized distinctions;
- all stable requirement and prediction identifiers;
- implementation-blind authorship and every existing nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, schemas, configuration, tests, audits, repairs,
validation, reductions, generated products, defaults, historical behavior, or
production state.

Do not renumber SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-001--036 or
SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--021. Append identifiers only for genuinely new
normative clauses.

======================================================================
1. CLOSE GENERAL-LINEAR VERSUS CONVOLUTION SCOPE
======================================================================

The r0.1 core defines a general finite same-grid L_Theta but defines scientific
support and edge behavior only through a convolution offset set K_Theta.

Return one exact owner disposition.

Preferred v0.1 disposition:

    The only numerically admitted base family is FLT-FIXED-CONV.

    L_Theta is the complete matrix representation of that exact realized
    sampled convolution. It is not a separately selectable arbitrary dense
    linear-operator family.

    FLT-FIXED-CONV-LOWPASS is a qualified subtype of FLT-FIXED-CONV.

If a general fixed-linear family is retained instead, generalize every
support, edge, influence, response, covariance, impulse, and null-space rule
using an exact row-specific required dependency set:

    K_p^req = {q required by row p}.

Do not leave a generic L family governed by convolution-only footprint
semantics.

======================================================================
2. MAKE LINEARITY CONDITIONAL ON ONE FROZEN REALIZED SELECTOR
======================================================================

Separate:

- the externally resolved fixed operator plan L_Theta;
- the parent-state-dependent but immutable realized row selector J_full;
- the complete applied operator A_Theta,J.

Use:

    J_full
      = J(plan,
          immutable parent domain,
          FLT input admission,
          availability,
          finiteness,
          support,
          required predicates)

resolved before payload arithmetic;

    A_Theta,J = J_full L_Theta;

    y = A_Theta,J m.

State:

- strict linearity is conditional on fixed parent membership and J_full;
- response, covariance, noise realizations, and NOI members receive the same
  A_Theta,J;
- J_full is never re-resolved for a response perturbation, covariance draw, or
  fixed-state NOI member;
- a member failing a required frozen footprint becomes unavailable rather than
  receiving another selector;
- selection/support uncertainty is not included in conditional
  L C L^T propagation unless separately supplied.

Update the rationale so “strict linearity” cannot be interpreted as global
linearity across parents with different support or validity.

======================================================================
3. DEFINE REQUIRED FOOTPRINT AND ZERO-COEFFICIENT SEMANTICS
======================================================================

Define separately:

    K_geom   = declared geometric/storage footprint;
    K_nonzero = exact nonzero sampled-coefficient support;
    K_req    = exact parent locations scientifically required by the method.

Use K_req in S_out.

State the relation among these sets for every admitted kernel family. Exact
zero is established by the declared coefficient representation, not a floating
threshold.

Owner-disposition these special cases:

A. identity operator:
       K_req = {0};
       S_out equals the exact admitted finite parent-row domain;

B. zero operator:
       it shall not obtain all storage rows through a vacuous empty-footprint
       predicate;
       it inherits an exact declared parent-support row domain, preferably the
       admitted finite parent rows, while producing numerical zero there;

C. geometric zeros:
       state whether zero-valued stored coefficients require a parent row.

Preserve geometric, signed, absolute, squared, and required-dependency support
as distinct objects.

Add predictions for exact-zero coefficients and zero-operator row support.

======================================================================
4. REPAIR PUBLICATION LIFECYCLE CIRCULARITY
======================================================================

Do not require a realized bundle before output-publication policy can apply.

Introduce a pre-publication state such as:

    applied_complete_candidate

or:

    publication_candidate.

Use the lifecycle:

    requested
      -> effective
      -> resolved
      -> applied
      -> complete publication candidate
      -> publication decision
      -> realized | failed | not_produced.

SCI-FLT-FIXED:output_publication@1 applies to the complete candidate.

A successful realized publication decision creates the realized product.

Disabled remains not produced. Identity and zero become realized products only
after the same complete sequence.

======================================================================
5. REMOVE NOI PRODUCT FROM FLT ATOMIC COMPLETION
======================================================================

The actual separately owned NOI-UNC[FLT-SIG] product shall not be a required
member of the atomic FLT bundle.

Replace that entry with an optional relation/state such as:

    FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY
    FLT-NOI-ATTACHMENT-STATE

containing:

- exact FLT product identity;
- compatible fixed operator and row-domain identity;
- whether a NOI attachment was requested;
- attached NOI product identity if later realized;
- typed unavailable/not-requested/failed state.

The actual NOI product remains a separately parented, separately realized
product and never changes whether the FLT bundle was complete or realized.

======================================================================
6. TYPE INPUT, ROW, AND PUBLICATION POLICIES
======================================================================

Define exact policy object domains.

Preferred separation:

    SCI-FLT-FIXED:input_bundle_admission@1
    SCI-FLT-FIXED:input_row_admission@1
    SCI-FLT-FIXED:output_publication@1.

Every profile shall bind:

- scientific-policy owner;
- exact source and boundary versions;
- request;
- applicability;
- eligibility;
- realization;
- restrictions;
- decisive exclusions;
- exceptions;
- missing/conflict behavior;
- lifecycle;
- exact consumer action.

Use VAL-congruent states:

- structural identity/source conflict:
      applicability_unknown / decision_unavailable;

- known applicable failed restriction:
      ineligible;

- not requested or effectively disabled:
      no eligibility proposition / not_produced;

- eligible but failed transformation:
      eligible / realization_failed;

- eligible complete publication candidate:
      realized only after successful publication action.

Companion qualification shall be request-specific:

A. base signal request:
   requires exact response/covariance state records but may permit those states
   to be unavailable;

B. response-qualified request:
   requires an available exact compatible response;

C. covariance-qualified request:
   requires the exact declared compatible covariance representation;

D. response-and-covariance-qualified request:
   requires both.

Do not block an otherwise valid signal-only product merely because an optional
companion is honestly unavailable.

Do not claim Registry evaluation until the profile bytes and source bindings
are owner-approved and registered.

======================================================================
7. TYPE RESPONSE FAMILIES AND ZERO-OPERATOR CLAIMS
======================================================================

Define separately:

1. fixed-state linear parent response:

       R_out^fixed = A_Theta,J R_parent^fixed;

2. already realized parent-grid response companion:

       apply A_Theta,J exactly once;

3. parent full-procedure finite difference with FLT fixed:

       Delta y_parent-FP
         = A_Theta,J Delta m_parent-FP,

   while retaining the parent state-change record separately;

4. FLT re-resolved procedure response:

   outside SCI-FLT-FIXED whenever kernel, cutoff, normalization, support,
   selector, edge state, or method is re-resolved.

No response family shall be silently represented by another.

Owner-disposition the exact zero operator:

- its local fixed-state derivative is zero;
- its parent-payload conditional covariance contribution is zero;
- the complete source-domain response may remain unavailable when source basis,
  domain, or parent-response identity is unavailable;
- total systematic uncertainty remains separately typed.

Do not collapse local zero response into an unsupported complete sky-response
claim, but do not hide a mathematically established local zero derivative.

======================================================================
8. REPAIR COVARIANCE TYPES AND NOTATION
======================================================================

Separate two axes.

Parent stochastic authority:

- complete covariance;
- explicit independent-diagonal model;
- marginal variances only;
- structured or partial model;
- unavailable.

Output representation:

- complete matrix;
- exact linear/operator representation;
- structured representation;
- marginal plane;
- summary only;
- unavailable.

Every result shall state:

- the parent model it is conditional on;
- output representation;
- domain and ordering;
- rank and null space;
- omitted terms;
- supported operations;
- selection, kernel, beam, WCS, calibration, and model uncertainty exclusions.

Replace undefined k[i,j] covariance notation with:

    A_ij = (J_full L_Theta)_ij

    Var(y_i) = sum_j A_ij^2 V_j

    Cov(y_i,y_l) = sum_j A_ij A_lj V_j.

A full matrix propagated from a declared independent-diagonal parent model may
be complete relative to that conditional model, but shall not imply that
unknown real parent cross terms are zero.

======================================================================
9. COMPLETE LOW-PASS, WCS, AND TRANSFER SEMANTICS
======================================================================

For every convolution declare whether it is:

- pixel-index-domain;
- affine tangent-plane angular-domain;
- or another exact coordinate-domain method.

A fixed shift-invariant pixel kernel shall not be called one spatially uniform
angular kernel over a WCS for which that relation is not established.

For angular-frequency low-pass qualification, require either:

A. one exact affine/constant tangent-plane pixel metric; or

B. another exact method proving the stated angular transfer.

Separate:

- sampled-kernel or interior translation-invariant transfer;
- complete finite row-restricted operator A_Theta,J.

Do not claim that the complete finite operator has one global Fourier transfer
unless an exact theorem establishes it.

Append a low-pass numerical prediction that independently evaluates the exact
sampled transfer and checks:

- DC gain;
- passband bounds;
- transition;
- stopband attenuation;
- phase;
- anisotropy;
- exact frequency grid and metric.

PRED-021 metadata completeness remains necessary but is not sufficient.

======================================================================
10. DEFINE OPERATOR ORDER AND COMPOSITION
======================================================================

Return one exact base-v0.1 rule.

Preferred narrow rule:

    One SCI-FLT-FIXED product applies one exact resolved sampled convolution.

A plan may supply a final kernel that was constructed elsewhere, but the FLT
product makes no intermediate transformation claim.

If ordered composition is admitted, bind:

- every constituent operator;
- exact application order and count;
- every intermediate row selector and support state;
- intermediate versus final normalization;
- final composed operator;
- response, covariance, influence, mode, and NOI propagation through the same
  order.

Do not assume:

    J2 L2 J1 L1 = Jfinal L2 L1

or reorder finite operators because ideal convolution kernels commute.

======================================================================
11. ADD NUMERICAL-CONFORMANCE POLICY
======================================================================

Preserve exact operator coefficients and scientific identity.

For future finite-precision implementation evidence, require one preregistered
numerical comparison policy defining:

- independent exact or high-precision oracle;
- absolute, relative, and near-zero behavior;
- signed-cancellation and zero-sum cases;
- conditioning and operation-count dependence;
- covariance comparison;
- sequential/parallel agreement;
- overflow, underflow, and non-finite handling;
- simultaneous row-level comparison;
- lifecycle and provenance;
- prohibition on changing bounds after observing a failure.

The numerical policy authors no new filter science and supplies no validation
or performance claim.

======================================================================
12. EXPOSURE, TERMINOLOGY, AND OWNER METADATA
======================================================================

Add an explicit inherited exposure-lineage role or state.

It shall state:

- exact parent exposure product or typed absence;
- that FLT creates no physical exposure;
- that FLT-INFLUENCE is not exposure;
- that convolving an exposure plane is not authorized as filtered-signal
  physical exposure.

Define or remove the currently unexplained “confidence” state.

Clarify that “externally resolved” means resolved before application under one
exact FLT-owned plan; it does not transfer FLT policy or transformation
ownership to an unnamed producer.

Add:

    Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

to the core, rationale, and ECS covers and PDF author metadata.

======================================================================
13. SOURCE-PACKET CLOSURE
======================================================================

Return the actual exact bytes of:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED_AUTHOR_PACKET v0.1/r0.1;
- all 17 admitted source objects;
- scientific-owner decision artifact;
- SCI-MAP_TO_SCI-FLT-FIXED boundary;
- SCI-JINC_TO_SCI-FLT-FIXED boundary;
- SCI-FLT-FIXED_TO_SCI-NOI boundary;
- all profile drafts;
- TRACEABILITY.json;
- BUILD_BINDING.json;
- exact normative source;
- rationale/ECS source;
- build recipe and tools;
- source-byte, parity, rebuild, and visual-QA reports.

Reproduce every SHA-256 printed by the PDFs.

If a claimed boundary, decision, policy, or byte-equality result cannot be
reproduced, return only its dependent route to typed unavailability rather than
modifying unrelated fixed-filter science.

======================================================================

======================================================================

Return:

1. revised SCI-FLT-FIXED Normative Core r0.2;
2. revised Scientist Rationale r0.2;
3. revised Engineering Conformance Specification r0.2;
4. exact admitted source packet and manifest;
5. fixed-family scope disposition;
6. conditional-row-selector amendment;

8. publication-lifecycle amendment;
9. NOI attachment-boundary amendment;
10. exact profile records and VAL binding status;
11. response-family crosswalk;
12. covariance type/representation table;
13. WCS/low-pass/transfer decision;
14. operator-composition decision;
15. numerical-conformance policy draft;
16. equation/requirement/prediction semantic-change map;
17. owner-decision parity report;
18. core/rationale/ECS parity report;
19. PDF visual-QA and metadata report.

Do not claim implementation conformity, achieved response or covariance,
numerical adequacy, validation, calibration, observational performance,
readiness, scientific freeze, production suitability, production
authorization, or Unity activity.
